# ChiaraAI Consulting

> ChiaraAI Consulting is a Gothenburg-based web and app development consultancy. We design and build custom websites, web apps and digital products for startups and established businesses in Gothenburg and across Sweden.

Every project starts with a free consultation and a fixed quote before any work begins.

## Services
- Websites: custom design, mobile-optimised, basic SEO, contact forms and online booking. From 14,900 kr.
- Web Apps: user accounts, databases and admin panels, Stripe payments and subscriptions, media libraries. From 49,900 kr.
- Custom Products: mobile apps, platforms, marketplaces and integrations. Quote after consultation.
- Care plans: hosting, security updates, backups and small changes from 500 kr/mån.
All prices exclude VAT (moms).
